newsitem.title: USA: US spot prod diffs near flat at close, NYMEX falls.
newsitem.headline: US spot prod diffs near flat at close, NYMEX falls.

text.p: U.S. spot product differentials saw little movement by mid-afternoon Wednesday, though outright prices fell sharply, tracking the declines on the NYMEX.
NYMEX May heating oil shed about 1.25 cents ahead of its settlement while May gasoline dipped 1.97 cents. Market watchers pointed to bearish technical factors for the selloff.
Activity in the spot markets picked up slightly from the torpor that marked the previous few days, traders said.
"I think we've hit the spring doldrums early this year," one market player said of the modest activity.
U.S. Gulf No. 2 oil diffs firmed slightly, with back 10th cycle barrels on the Colonial offered at 1.75 cents under the NYMEX print, up about 0.10 cent on the day.
USG low sulphur diesel, however, remained steady, with players putting 10th cycle barrels between about 0.45 and 0.60 cents over the screen.
Gasoline diffs were flat with back 10th cycle USG M1 unleaded gasoline offered at 3.20 cents under the screen and late April barrels offered at 3.45 cents under.
New York Harbor prompt M2 barrels were offered at 2.25 cents under the print, steady with late Tuesday levels.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
